description.en: Fades a character (or an array of them) in or out over _frm frames without waiting. With _alpha above 0 it sets the alpha to 0, shows the object and fades to _alpha. Otherwise it fades from 1.0 to _alpha and hides the object at once (CMND_SET_ENABLE false), so the fade-out is not visible. StandEventCharaFadeWait is the version that waits and hides after the fade. No shipped script calls this one.
Character handle or array of handles.
Target alpha: above 0 to fade in, 0 to fade out.
Length of the fade in frames.

examples.case: Fading a model in without waiting (not found in script_clean/; invented)
